report.headline: Southampton's Late Surge Secures Victory Against Stoke City
summary_paragraphs: Southampton claimed a convincing 3-1 victory over Stoke City in the Championship, showcasing their attacking prowess. Cyle Larin opened the scoring early in the match, netting a goal in the 8th minute to set a positive tone for the home side.

Despite Southampton's strong start, Stoke City managed to equalize through Ethan Galbraith in the 26th minute, leveling the match at 1-1. This goal demonstrated Stoke's resilience and ability to respond under pressure.

As the match progressed, Southampton continued to apply pressure, and their efforts paid off when Divin Mubama scored in the 89th minute, restoring their lead to 2-1. This late goal was crucial in shifting the momentum back in favor of the home team.

In stoppage time, Ryan Manning converted a penalty in the 90+4 minute, sealing the victory at 3-1. This decisive sequence highlighted Southampton's ability to capitalize on critical moments and secure the win.

report.headline: Stoke City Falls Short Against Southampton Amid Late Goals
summary_paragraphs: Stoke City faced a disappointing 3-1 defeat against Southampton in their latest Championship outing. The match began with an early goal from Southampton's Cyle Larin in the 8th minute, setting a challenging tone for the away side. However, Stoke responded positively, with Ethan Galbraith equalizing in the 26th minute, showcasing their resilience.

As the match progressed, Stoke struggled to maintain pressure, recording only 29.4% pressure share throughout the game. Southampton capitalized on this, applying sustained pressure during crucial moments, particularly from the 63rd to the 84th minute, which ultimately led to their decisive late goals.

The turning point came in the 89th minute when Divin Mubama restored Southampton's lead, followed by a penalty conversion by Ryan Manning in stoppage time, sealing the victory at 3-1. These late goals shifted the momentum decisively in favor of the home side, illustrating the importance of maintaining focus until the final whistle.
